1.4.0: Rework Langfuse trace hierarchy for streaming: disable SDK auto-telemetry and build spans manually. Hierarchy: Appmixer AI Agent (AGENT) > generation (SPAN, input=system+messages, output=final text) > model_step_N (SPAN, input=req body, output=text+toolcalls, usage) > tool_call:name (SPAN, model decision) + text (SPAN, text chunk) + tool execution spans (SPAN, input=args, output=result).
1.3.0: Fix Langfuse generation spans showing no input/output/toolCalls: removed functionId from experimental_telemetry — the prefix it added to span names (e.g. 'appmixer-ai-agent:ai.streamText.doStream') broke Langfuse OTLP ingestion's name-based mapping of ai.prompt.messages and ai.response.toolCalls.
Fix total cost not shown on agent span: stamp gen_ai.usage.input_tokens/output_tokens and gen_ai.request.model on the agent span after run() so Langfuse can compute aggregate cost.

Fix tool call span nested under root Agent instead of under the step's generation: drop capturedCtx override and rely on AsyncLocalStorageContextManager for natural OTEL context propagation — the SDK's ai.streamText span is active when execute() is called, so tool spans are now correctly nested as siblings of the doStream GENERATION observations.
1.2.0: Fix Langfuse tracing: tool call spans were being silently dropped by @langfuse/otel v5 LangfuseSpanProcessor. The processor's isDefaultExportSpan filter requires a gen_ai.* attribute to pass. Added gen_ai.operation.name: 'execute_tool' and gen_ai.tool.name to all tool spans so they are correctly exported and appear in Langfuse traces.
1.1.0: Fix Langfuse tracing: tool call spans were not appearing in Langfuse traces.

Root causes: (1) tool spans were parented to the wrong OTEL context because async-context propagation through the Vercel AI SDK was unavailable; fixed by capturing the agent span OTEL context synchronously in buildVercelTools and passing it explicitly to executeToolByName. (2) langfuse.observation.type was set to 'tool' which is not a valid Langfuse type; changed to 'span'. (3) Added @opentelemetry/context-async-hooks dependency for proper async context propagation.
